description: Adds a new, empty store to the login's agency, with its own cards, posters and locations: for a client, a second business, or a demo to show a prospect. Then set it up with create_card, create_poster and create_location using the returned store_id. Don't use this to set up a store the login already has: call list_stores first and use the existing store if it's the same business.

agency_id.description: Agency id from list_stores. Only needed when this login runs several agencies.

intent.description: Optional. One short sentence on what the person asked you to do, e.g. "Set up a stamp card for Ground Up Café". Leal shows it in the person's activity log under Settings → AI agents, so they can see what was done for them. Leave out customer details.

logo_url.description: Public https URL of the wide logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG), e.g. from get_brand_kit.

name.description: Store name in Leal, usually the business or client name, e.g. "Bean There Coffee".

square_logo_url.description: Public https URL of a square logo or icon.

store_name.description: Public name customers see on cards and signup pages, if different from name.

name: create_store
title: Create a store
